output.name: Ulkun
output.myth: Every trader keeps a salt pot in the hold, and into it goes the crew's share: one pinch from every catch and sale. Ulkun is the pot the sky keeps. Hesk the Reel counts the pinches on her string, and counts them twice, because she is patient and the sea is not. Once a moon the pot is tipped, when Sil has gone dark searching the water for her brother Aun. Tavo the Gale comes down the road and leans on the rim. The salt runs out over the dark, south toward Ommen, where the Lamp Boat keeps a lantern for every drowned name. The crew says it is the share spilling for those who went aloft and never sat down to eat. Varesk, the short-salted Late Boat, to the north-west, gets the first pinch of it. Do not laugh when Tavo does this. He does not like it, and he will tip the next pot too. Before you sleep, set one pinch aside for whoever is out past the Leeward light, and count it twice. Hesk is still counting.
output.finding: From Ommen, the Lamp Boat, look about three-quarters of a hand-span (one and a half fists) due north, and Ulkun sits there in the Leeward Reach.
